caption:
Meta just hit pause on its new business rules after publishers and brands threw a major fit. Turns out you cannot just change the terms of the game when the players refuse to run. 📉

Would you fold or fight back if a tech giant changed the rules on you? Let me know below.

Source: Storyboard18

#Meta #DigitalMarketing #Advertising #SocialMediaNews #PublisherNews

post.news: Meta delayed its new commercial terms to November 20 after receiving heavy backlash from publishers and advertisers.
post.take: When the people paying your bills start yelling, even the tech giant hits the snooze button.
post.insight: Even the biggest platforms have to listen when advertisers push back hard enough on new rules.
